## Node Packages
 - A panel next to the editor: search a package on the npm registry and tap **Install**
 - No terminal — the install runs inside the proot Debian with live output in the log box
 - Curated list of recommended libraries (Essentials, Frontend, Backend, Dev Tooling, Testing) filtered as you type
 - Installs into the open project when one is open, otherwise installs globally
 - Missing Node.js/npm is installed automatically before the first package
 - Buttons for clearing the log, and a free-form install box for any npm package
 - Colours come from the IDE theme through `M3Theme`, so it follows light/dark and every colour scheme
 - Built with Material 3 and RecyclerView for a light, fast list
